title: Releases and feedback
label: TIKTOK SHOP · DEVELOPER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-07-27
html:
Check the installed and latest versions

tts_open_toolkit version
tts_open_toolkit update --check

TTS Open Toolkit CLI on npm

Keep skills current

tts_open_toolkit skill state --agent codex --json
tts_open_toolkit skill add --agent codex --update

Repeat with the target used by your AI agent or project.

Follow platform changes

TikTok Shop developer Changelog The platform Changelog covers API and developer-product changes. Review it together with the API reference and your repository before deciding impact.

Submit feedback

Use the English feedback form for installation, upgrade, authentication, App/sandbox access, DevAPI, answer quality, or feature requests. TTS Open Toolkit Feedback Form

Include

  • Operating system, Node version, CLI version, and AI agent.
  • Your goal, reproduction steps, expected result, and actual result.
  • Sanitized request ID, error code, log ID, or screenshot when available.

💡 Never submit OAuth tokens, authorization codes, App Secrets, cookies, private keys, passwords, or protected credential-store contents.

Join the developer community

Join TTS Open Toolkit | Developer Community to discuss integration questions, exchange implementation practices, and share product feedback with other developers. Join TTS Open Toolkit | Developer Community
